item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
Lumary Audio 1.4.1
Fixes sound problems on macOS 27.
• With one interface as both your mic and your headphones, Live could be silent, or a take could come out sped up with a crackle. Both are fixed.
• With the mic and headphones on different devices, the sound no longer clicks every few seconds.
• If an interface ever drops audio this way again, Lumary Audio moves it to a safer path by itself, and a take always plays back at the speed you recorded it.
Takes recorded with the problem can't be repaired: the missing audio was never captured.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
